When it opens you'll find kettlebells, assault bikes, battle ropes, a cold plunge, and a custom sand pit out there, nothing like it around Teaneck.

We built this place together from the start, and the Coliseum is no different (every load of that gravel went in by hand), so we want you out there with us when the doors open. Coming soon.

#differentbreed #thecoliseum #teaneck #builtbyhand #njfitness

James Lyons had a heart attack in December of 2021. He says it was a bad one and it almost took him out.

One of the things he did to recover was start training boxing here at Different Breed, and it was rough at the beginning. He describes that first year as wading through cement.

Then he signed up for Blue Collar Boxing and fought in our ring. His opponent was half his age and outweighed him by 45 pounds, and James got the W.

He still takes medicine every day and he will for the rest of his life, and he says he feels recovered from the heart attack because of boxing.

Coach Pablo cornered him through all of it.

#becauseofboxing #bobstories #differentbreedboxing #boxingchangedme #teaneck
